rows.engineering_basis: Parameterized ambiguous silhouette; not a pixel-identical reproduction of a historical plate.
limitations: The generator verifies geometry and luminance, not bistable reports.
rows.supported_claim: The entry instantiates a controllable ambiguous-figure stimulus family.

rows.engineering_basis: Equal central patches on unequal luminance surrounds.
limitations: Display calibration and observer adaptation are not modeled.
rows.supported_claim: The physical center patches are matched while surround luminance differs.

rows.engineering_basis: Alternating rectangular masks at a fixed rational frame rate.
limitations: The artifact establishes temporal succession, not perceived motion.
rows.supported_claim: The sequence contains controlled successive spatial events.

rows.engineering_basis: Additive octave-spaced partials with a deterministic envelope.
limitations: Playback transducers and listener pitch judgments are external.
rows.supported_claim: The audio contains octave-related partials with controlled sweep parameters.

rows.engineering_basis: Harmonic components are synthesized while the nominal fundamental is omitted.
limitations: Pitch completion is an observer-level inference.
rows.supported_claim: The nominal fundamental component is absent from the canonical spectrum.

rows.engineering_basis: One flash paired with one or two timed beeps on a shared clock.
limitations: The stimulus does not establish a reported flash count.
rows.supported_claim: The declared beep/flash event counts and offsets are physically encoded.

rows.engineering_basis: Stereo panning and visual displacement encode a spatial discrepancy.
limitations: Perceived localization depends on room, headphones, display, and observer.
rows.supported_claim: The audio and visual channels carry a declared spatial discrepancy.

rows.engineering_basis: Equal bars with controlled arrow-wing geometry.
limitations: The chosen normalized geometry is one engineering variant.
rows.supported_claim: The two bar lengths are equal in the canonical raster while wing geometry varies.

rows.engineering_basis: A diagonal continuation is separated by a rectangular occluder.
limitations: Alignment judgments and orientation filters are not measured.
rows.supported_claim: The occluder and diagonal continuation are generated from explicit geometry.

rows.engineering_basis: Equal target bars are placed inside converging rails.
limitations: Perspective interpretation is observer- and display-dependent.
rows.supported_claim: Target bars are physically equal and rails converge toward a vanishing region.

rows.engineering_basis: Three incomplete circular inducers are rasterized around a triangular gap.
limitations: Illusory contour completion is not directly measured.
rows.supported_claim: The image contains incomplete inducers with no explicitly drawn triangle edge.

rows.engineering_basis: Equal central targets are surrounded by different context-circle sizes.
limitations: Perceived size depends on viewing scale and context.
rows.supported_claim: Central target geometry is held equal while contextual circle geometry differs.

rows.engineering_basis: Vertical long lines crossed by short oblique inducers with explicit normalized spacing and angle.
limitations: The raster verifies line geometry, not orientation judgments or a pixel-identical historical reproduction.
rows.supported_claim: The entry instantiates a controlled crossing-line orientation stimulus family.

rows.engineering_basis: Two octave-complex tones are separated by a half-octave interval.
limitations: Ascending/descending reports vary across listeners and contexts.
rows.supported_claim: The canonical pair has an explicit half-octave frequency relation.

rows.engineering_basis: Alternating high and low tones are assigned to opposite stereo channels.
limitations: The auditory percept depends on dichotic presentation and listener.
rows.supported_claim: The two channels receive alternating octave-related tones.

rows.engineering_basis: An interrupted sinusoidal carrier is replaced during a declared gap by a deterministic tone or white-noise masker with typed amplitude.
limitations: The generator reports the physical interruption and masker, not a listener's continuity judgment or sensory-versus-decisional effect.
rows.supported_claim: The canonical audio contains a reproducible interruption interval and masker family.

rows.engineering_basis: A visual flash and audio click share a clock with explicit offset.
limitations: The generated single-event pair is a simplified engineering stimulus.
rows.supported_claim: Audio and video event timing and declared offset are deterministic and inspectable.

rows.engineering_basis: Requires validated speech audio/video fixtures and licensing records.
limitations: No fixture, consent record, or perceptual validation contract is bundled.
rows.supported_claim: The catalog identifies a speech-dependent audiovisual family without claiming implementation.
